text: Yes, the 2022 loss was detected with Sentinel-2 imagery. The evidence shows a tree-cover loss of about 0.6 hectares within the asset in 2022, mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data. The loss was observed in a later year (2025) and meets the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 hectares. The imagery confirms the change, though it does not specify the cause or legality of the loss.
